answer.text: The period before the fund starts investing
The period following expiry of the liquidation period for liquidating unliquidated investments of the scheme, after requisite investor consent
The marketing period before first close

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.11 of the workbook defines the dissolution period as the period following expiry of the liquidation period during which the scheme liquidates its remaining unliquidated investments, undertaken after obtaining the requisite investor consent. The Trap: The dissolution period is not the pre-investment phase, the entire fund tenure, or the marketing period; it is the post-liquidation phase for residual investments. Note: Based on workbook pages 217 and 220-221 (Section 10.11).
